# treecluster output evaluation

## v3 changes
* n clusters,mean and median size changed to not include singletons
* make versions of eval plots that do not have legends (composite only has one legend) and additional plot for median
* move composite plot inside and with seg_leg

## Objectives
* Read in the csv file to parse the clusters, members, size for range of thresholds and segments
* Compare the different cutoffs and word lengths

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(NatParksPalettes)
library(gtools)
library(cowplot)

```

#Ins and Outs
```{r}
files.in<-list.files("../00_tc_run/2026-02-09_ft_treecluster_maxclade_out/",pattern=".csv", full.names = T) %>% mixedsort()

f.out<-paste0(Sys.Date(), "_treecluster_maxclade_eval_out/")
if(!dir.exists(f.out)){dir.create(f.out)}

#plotting theme
plot.theme<-theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                  panel.background = element_rect("grey95"), 
                  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
                  text=element_text(size=10,face="bold"),
                  legend.text=element_text(size=8),
                  axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45,hjust=1,vjust=1))
```

## Loop over all files, plot results, extract a summary table 
```{r}
#Empty list to hold the files
l.f<-length(files.in)
summ.list<-replicate(n=l.f, vector())

i=1
for (i in 1:l.f){
  
  file.in<-files.in[i]
  
  tc <- read.csv(file.in, header = TRUE, sep="\t")
  seg<-str_extract(file.in, paste0("(?<=", "\\/\\/", ").*?(?=", "_cluster_max", ")"))
  method<-str_extract(file.in, paste0("(?<=", "\\_cluster_", ").*?(?=", "_t0\\.", ")")) #ie. maxclade
  thresh<-str_extract(file.in, paste0("(?<=", "\\_t0", ").*?(?=", "\\.csv", ")")) #replaces thresh
  thresh<-as.character(as.numeric(thresh))
  colnames(tc)[str_which(colnames(tc),"Cluster")]<-"cluster"
  
  tc$method<-method #for future ref
  tc$seg<-seg
  tc$thresh<-thresh
  
  # anything assigned cluster -1 is a single: assign their own cluster
  singlez<-which(tc$cluster==-1)  
  tc$cluster[singlez]<-paste0("s_",1:length(singlez))
  
  #make a df of unique clusters, cluster size
  tc.cl<-tc %>% group_by(cluster) %>% 
    summarize(.groups="rowwise",
              size=n()) 
  
  tc.cl<-tc.cl[order(tc.cl$size, decreasing = T),]
  clust.ord<-tc.cl$cluster
  tc.cl$cluster<-factor(tc.cl$cluster, levels=clust.ord)
  tc.cl$method<-method #for future ref
  tc.cl$seg<-seg
  tc.cl$thresh<-thresh
  
  #Summarize entire treecluster run
  tc.cl.summ<-as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(summary(tc.cl$size))))
  tc.cl.summ$n.clusters<-nrow(tc.cl)
  tc.cl.summ$n.singles<-length(which(tc.cl$size ==1))
  tc.cl.summ$min.no.sing=min(tc.cl$size[which(tc.cl$size!=1)])
  tc.cl.summ$sd=sd(tc.cl$size)
  tc.cl.summ$method<-method
  tc.cl.summ$seg<-seg
  tc.cl.summ$thresh<-thresh
  tc.cl.summ <- tc.cl.summ %>% 
    mutate( #include no singles metrics
      ratio.max.min = Max. / min.no.sing,
      n.clusters.nosing = n.clusters - n.singles,
      mean.nosing = mean(tc.cl$size[which(tc.cl$size != 1)]),
      median.nosing = median(tc.cl$size[which(tc.cl$size != 1)]) )
  
  summ.list[[i]]<-tc.cl.summ
  
  key.features<-paste0("TreeCluster threshold: ",thresh,
                       "\nN clusters: ",tc.cl.summ$n.clusters.nosing[1],
                       "\nN singles: ",tc.cl.summ$n.singles[1],
                       "\nMax size: ", tc.cl.summ$Max.[1],
                       "\nMean size: ", sprintf("%.1f",tc.cl.summ$mean.nosing[1]),
                       "\nMedian size: ", tc.cl.summ$median.nosing[1])
  # tc.df<-data.frame(segment=seg)
  
  ## plot LOG cluster sizes and annotate run with key features (no single)
  tc.cl %>%
    filter(size!=1) %>%
    ggplot()+
      geom_bar(aes(x=cluster,y=log10(size), fill=cluster),stat="identity")+
      scale_fill_viridis_d(option="D")+
      labs(x="Cluster",y="Log10 (cluster size)")+
      ggtitle(paste0("TreeCluster: ",seg, ", ", method, " method"))+
      annotate(geom="label",x=tc.cl.summ$n.clusters.nosing*0.5, y=log10(tc.cl.summ$Max.), hjust=0, vjust=1, label=key.features)+
      plot.theme+
      theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x=element_blank())
  ggsave(paste0(f.out, "logclustsize_",seg,"_", method,"_",thresh,".tiff"), height=3, width=5, units="in") 
  
   ## plot cluster sizes and annotate run with key features
  tc.cl %>%
    filter(size!=1) %>%
    ggplot()+
      geom_bar(aes(x=cluster,y=(size), fill=cluster),stat="identity")+
      scale_fill_viridis_d(option="D")+
      labs(x="Cluster",y="Cluster size")+
      ggtitle(paste0("TreeCluster: ",seg, ", ", method, " method"))+
      annotate(geom="label",x=tc.cl.summ$n.clusters.nosing*0.5, y=(tc.cl.summ$Max.), hjust=0, vjust=1, label=key.features)+
      plot.theme+
      theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x=element_blank())
  ggsave(paste0(f.out, "clustsize_",seg,"_", method,"_",thresh,".tiff"), height=3, width=5, units="in") 
  
  #write tc to use for cluster identity
  write.csv(tc, paste0(f.out, "tc-out_",seg,"_", method, "_",  thresh,".csv"))
  
  #write tc to use for cluster chars
  write.csv(tc.cl, paste0(f.out, "tc-cl-out_",seg,"_",method, "_",  thresh,".csv"))
} #end of loop across all the cluster files (outputs from treecluster for diff method)
```

## plot summ list by segment 
```{r}
# segment colors
segments<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS")
segment.cols<-natparks.pals(name="Yellowstone", n=length(segments))
segment.cols<-segment.cols[c(1,5,2,4,6,3,8,7)]
names(segment.cols)<-segments

## join all the elems into one df
tc.cl.summ.all<-bind_rows(summ.list)
tc.cl.summ.all<-tc.cl.summ.all %>% mutate(max.min.ratio = Max. / min.no.sing, remove=F)
tc.cl.summ.all$seg<-factor(tc.cl.summ.all$seg, levels=segments)
tc.cl.summ.all$thresh<-as.numeric(tc.cl.summ.all$thresh) 

#plot by segment: n cluster nosing
tc.cl.summ.all %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=thresh, y=n.clusters.nosing, group=seg, color=seg)) +
  geom_point()+
  # geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = F, linewidth = )+
  scale_color_manual(values=segment.cols)+
  plot.theme+
  labs(x="TreeCluster maximum tree distance (sub/site)", y="N clusters (excl. singletons)", color="Segment")+
  theme(legend.position = "top")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, method, "_threshold_vs_Ncluster.nosing.tiff"),height=4,width=4)

#plot by segment: n singles
tc.cl.summ.all %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x=thresh, y=n.singles, group=seg, color=seg))+
  scale_color_manual(values=segment.cols)+
  plot.theme+
  labs(x="TreeCluster maximum tree distance (sub/site)", y="N singles", color="Segment")+
  theme(legend.position = "top")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, method,"_threshold_vs_Nsingle.tiff"),height=4,width=4)


#plot by segment: mean size
tc.cl.summ.all %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x=thresh, y=mean.nosing, group=seg, color=seg))+
  scale_color_manual(values=segment.cols)+
  plot.theme+
  labs(x="TreeCluster maximum tree distance (sub/site)", y="Mean size (excl. singletons)", color="Segment")+
  theme(legend.position = "top")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, method,"_threshold_vs_meansize.tiff"),height=4,width=4)

#plot by segment: median size
tc.cl.summ.all %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x=thresh, y=median.nosing, group=seg, color=seg))+
  scale_color_manual(values=segment.cols)+
  plot.theme+
  labs(x="TreeCluster maximum tree distance (sub/site)", y="Median size (excl. singletons)", color="Segment")+
  theme(legend.position = "top")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, method,"_threshold_vs_mediansize.tiff"),height=4,width=4)

#plot by segment: max size
tc.cl.summ.all %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x=thresh, y=Max., group=seg, color=seg))+
  scale_color_manual(values=segment.cols)+
  plot.theme+
  labs(x="TreeCluster maximum tree distance (sub/site)", y="Maximum size", color="Segment")+
  theme(legend.position = "top")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, method,"_threshold_vs_maxsize.tiff"),height=4,width=4)

#plot by segment: max/min ratio
tc.cl.summ.all %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x=thresh, y=max.min.ratio, group=seg, color=seg))+
  scale_color_manual(values=segment.cols)+
  plot.theme+
  labs(x="TreeCluster maximum tree distance (sub/site)", y="Max/min (no singles) size", color="Segment")+
  theme(legend.position = "top")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, method,"_threshold_vs_maxminratio.tiff"),height=4,width=4)
```

## same plots,no legends
```{r}

  # geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = F, linewidth = )+

## LEGEND ONLY
plot_legend <- get_legend(p4+
                            theme(legend.position = "top")+
                            guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1)))

ggsave(filename = paste0(f.out,"seg_leg.tiff"),
  plot = ggdraw(plot_legend), 
  width = 8, 
  height = 0.25, 
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300)
```

#composite plot 
```{r}
row1<-plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol=2,nrow=1, labels=c("A","B"),label_size = 16, align="hv")
row2<-plot_grid(p3.2,p4, ncol=2,nrow=1, labels=c("C","D"),label_size = 16, align="hv")
full_plot<-plot_grid(plot_legend, row1, row2, ncol=1, nrow=3,
                     rel_heights = c(0.25,3,3), rel_widths = c(1,1,1),
                     labels=NULL)

ggsave(plot = full_plot,filename = paste0(f.out, "composite_size_vs_thresh.tiff"),
       width=8,height=6.25,bg="white")
```
